module: Loading and saving of drag data. Reads the tracks (*.strip.json and *.dragSettings.json files, or old format converted), rebuilds lanes, waypoints, zones and timers, synchronizes the waypoints with the BeamNGWaypoint objects of the scene, precomputes the AI stop point, and spawns/removes the prefabs (tree, signs, decorations, paths). Also manages the player's files: best times per vehicle (dial book) and slip history, in the user's settings/ folder.
notes: Files written: settings/dragDialBest.json (best times per config hash), settings/dragDialHistory.jsonl (one JSON line per race, appended at the end of the file) and settings/dragDialTimes.json (old file, re-read and migrated once). Career backup copy: <save folder>/dragDialTimes.json.
The book keys are hashes of the vehicle's config file (FS:hashFile on pc_file) or 'vehicle_<id>' if unavailable; time_1_4 serves as the fallback value (10 s by default).
DEFAULT_TIMERS: reactionTime (0.178 m), time_60 (60 ft), time_330, time_1_8, time_1000, time_1_4 (important), velAt_1_8, velAt_1_4; distances in meters (402.336 m = 1/4 mile).

The lane waypoints are named <stripId>_wp_<type>_<lane> in the scene; those of the track <stripId>_<type>. They must exist in the level (prefab): the module does not create them, it renames them if needed and re-reads their transform.
Default phases of a track: stage (dependency), countdown (dependency), race, stop. Default values: dragType 'headsUpRace', context 'freeroam', tree '.500'.
normalizeTimersConfig does not keep shortLabel: the timers supplied by a dragSettings file lose this field (used by the slip), unlike DEFAULT_TIMERS.
The AI's automatic stop point (autoStopName) is searched in the navigation graph more than 350 m from the finish line, unless the track defines a drag_stop waypoint.

DEFAULT_TIMERS.desc: Default timers of a track: {id, label, labelKey, shortLabel, type = 'distanceTimer'|'velocity', distance (m), important}.

convertLegacyData.desc: Converts the old track format (stripInfo, strip.lanes) into the current structure (strip, lanes, waypoints), adds the default timers and synchronizes the waypoints with the scene.

returns.desc: Converted data, nil if legacyData is nil.

ensureDialCache.desc: Loads the dial book once per session (settings/dragDialTimes.json, .jsonl history, best times overlay) and migrates the old history out of the main JSON.

returns.desc: Cache keyed by vehicle config hash ({time_1_4, ..., history}).

generateHashFromFile.desc: Stable hash of the vehicle's config (hash of the .pc file) serving as the key for dial and history; cached. Returns 'vehicle_<id>' if the details or the file are unavailable.

getAllLanes.desc: All the lanes of all the tracks (*.strip.json) of the current level, with _stripId and _stripName added.

getAllStrips.desc: Raw data of all the *.strip.json tracks of the current level's dragstrips folder (with _filePath).

returns.desc: Path, nil (E log) if the level is unknown.

getDialTimes.desc: Best times per config hash, without the history; time_1_4 is at least 10 by default.

getHistory.desc: History of the recorded slips. With id, filters on the matching track of the current level (by dragSettings id, file name or strip id).

getRecentHistory.desc: The last count slips across all tracks, from most recent to oldest (stripInfo.timestamp).

laneWaypointSceneName.desc: Canonical name in the scene of a lane waypoint: <stripId>_wp_<type>_<lane> (the "_wp_" avoids collision with the tree lights).

loadCompleteDragRaceData.desc: Loads a full track from a .strip.json file: lanes (waypoints, boundary, zone, stageToEndNormalized), track waypoints, track zone, default phases/prefabs/timers; then synchronizes with the scene.

stripId.desc: Path of the strip JSON file.

returns.desc: Full data, nil (E log) on read failure.

loadDragStripData.desc: Loads a track settings file: modular format (stripId field pointing to a .strip.json, plus dragType, context, phases, prefabs, timers) or old format converted by convertLegacyData.

loadPrefabs.desc: Spawns in the scene the prefabs in use from data.prefabs (christmasTree, displaySign, decorations, paths) at the origin and stores their prefabId.

data.desc: Track data with prefabs[key] = {isUsed, path, treeType}.

onSaveCurrentProfile.desc: Hook: when the profile is saved, copies the dial book into the save folder (saveDialFile).

resolveAutoStopWaypoints.desc: Precomputes for each lane the name of the navigation node where the AI must stop (lane.autoStopName), more than 350 m from the finish line. Does nothing if the track has a drag_stop waypoint or if the graph does not exist.

saveDialTimes.desc: For each playable racer, updates its best time (important timer) if beaten, and adds the slip to the history (memory and .jsonl file, with configHash per driver). Writes settings/dragDialBest.json if a record changes.

timeslip.desc: Slip to record in the history.

saveLane.desc: Writes a lane as JSON (human-readable formatting).

saveStrip.desc: Writes a track as JSON after renaming each lane's waypoints according to laneWaypointSceneName.

strip.desc: Track (id, lanes with waypoints[] having a type).

syncDragStripWaypointsWithSceneTree.desc: For each lane and track waypoint, finds the scene's BeamNGWaypoint by its canonical name, renames it if needed, re-reads its position/rotation/scale, and computes lane.stageToEndNormalized. Rebuilds the navigation graph (map.reset) if a rename took place.

unloadPrefabs.desc: Removes the prefabs in use from the scene (by prefabId) and clears prefabId.
